fungal infection: Fungal Infection is characterized by skin itching, rashes, and nodular eruptions. It is caused by a fungus affecting the skin surface.
allergy: Allergy is caused by hypersensitivity to certain substances, often presenting with sneezing, skin rash, and watery eyes.
gerd: GERD (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease) causes acid to flow back into the esophagus, resulting in chest pain, indigestion, and acidity.
chronic cholestasis: Chronic Cholestasis is a liver condition involving reduced bile flow, commonly indicated by yellowing of skin, dark urine, and itching.
drug reaction: Drug Reaction occurs due to side effects of medications, often presenting with skin rash, itching, and stomach pain.
peptic ulcer diseae: Peptic Ulcer Disease involves sores on the stomach lining, causing vomiting, indigestion, and abdominal pain.
aids: AIDS (Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome) severely weakens the immune system, causing fatigue, weight loss, and diarrhea.
diabetes: Diabetes is a metabolic condition where blood sugar is chronically elevated, indicated by polyuria, excessive hunger, and fatigue.
gastroenteritis: Gastroenteritis is an intestinal infection causing vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain, often due to a virus or bacteria.
bronchial asthma: Bronchial Asthma is a chronic respiratory disease causing breathlessness, wheezing, and chest tightness triggered by allergens.
hypertension: Hypertension (high blood pressure) is a condition where blood pressure remains elevated, with symptoms of headache, dizziness, and chest pain.
migraine: Migraine is a severe recurring headache, often accompanied by nausea, sensitivity to light, and visual disturbances.
cervical spondylosis: Cervical Spondylosis is age-related wear in the neck joints causing neck pain, stiffness, dizziness, and loss of balance.
paralysis (brain hemorrhage): Paralysis from brain hemorrhage is caused by bleeding in the brain, leading to weakness on one side, altered sensorium, and vomiting.
jaundice: Jaundice is a yellowing of the skin and eyes caused by high bilirubin levels, accompanied by dark urine and fatigue.
malaria: Malaria is caused by a parasite spread through mosquito bites, presenting with high fever, chills, sweating, and headache.
chicken pox: Chickenpox is a highly contagious viral infection causing skin blisters, itching, fatigue, and mild fever.
dengue: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease causing high fever, severe joint pain, rash, and pain behind the eyes.
typhoid: Typhoid is a bacterial infection causing prolonged high fever, abdominal pain, headache, and vomiting.
hepatitis a: Hepatitis A is a liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus, with symptoms of jaundice, fatigue, and abdominal pain.
hepatitis b: Hepatitis B is a viral liver infection spread through blood and body fluids, causing fatigue, yellowing of skin, and abdominal pain.
hepatitis c: Hepatitis C is a bloodborne viral infection affecting the liver, causing fatigue, nausea, and yellowing of the eyes.
hepatitis d: Hepatitis D is a liver infection that only occurs alongside Hepatitis B, worsening liver damage and causing severe fatigue.
hepatitis e: Hepatitis E is a waterborne liver infection causing jaundice, fatigue, and abdominal pain, typically self-limiting.
alcoholic hepatitis: Alcoholic Hepatitis is liver inflammation caused by excessive alcohol consumption, presenting with jaundice, vomiting, and abdominal pain.
tuberculosis: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection primarily affecting the lungs, causing persistent cough, blood in sputum, night sweats, and weight loss.
common cold: A Common Cold is a viral upper respiratory infection presenting with runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, and mild fever.
pneumonia: Pneumonia is a lung infection causing chest pain, cough with phlegm, high fever, and breathlessness.
dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles): Piles (Hemorrhoids) are swollen veins in the rectum/anus causing pain, bleeding from the rectum, and constipation.
heart attack: A Heart Attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked, causing severe chest pain, sweating, and breathlessness.
varicose veins: Varicose Veins are swollen, enlarged veins caused by weakened valves, presenting with leg swelling and prominent veins.
hypothyroidism: Hypothyroidism is an underactive thyroid gland causing fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, and brittle nails.
hyperthyroidism: Hyperthyroidism is an overactive thyroid gland causing weight loss, fast heart rate, sweating, and anxiety.
hypoglycemia: Hypoglycemia is abnormally low blood sugar causing anxiety, sweating, vomiting, and fatigue.
osteoarthristis: Osteoarthritis is a joint disease causing knee pain, hip pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion.
arthritis: Arthritis is inflammation of the joints causing swelling, pain, stiffness, and reduced movement.
(vertigo) paroymsal positional vertigo: BPPV (Vertigo) causes brief episodes of dizziness triggered by head movements, with loss of balance and spinning sensations.
acne: Acne is a skin condition causing pimples, blackheads, and skin lesions, typically on the face and back.
urinary tract infection: UTI is a bacterial infection in the urinary tract causing burning urination, frequent urination, and bladder discomfort.
psoriasis: Psoriasis is a skin condition causing red, scaly patches, skin inflammation, and silver-like dusting of flakes.
impetigo: Impetigo is a highly contagious bacterial skin infection causing red sores, blisters, and yellow crust around the nose and mouth.
